sentence: This project uses deep learning to predict how climate change will affect karst groundwater resources.
This project builds theory tools that reduce uncertainty in how neutrino experiments are interpreted.
This project builds reference genomes for Antarctic species and an open platform that shares them.
This project designs nanomaterials that label therapeutic stem cells so they can be tracked with optical coherence tomography imaging.
This project replaces the glass and metal optics inside high-power lasers with plasma components so the lasers can be smaller.
This project uses computer simulations to study how magnetic fields form in turbulent plasma and how they become smooth.
This project builds programming language tools that manage computers with different types of memory.
This project builds software that helps analyze mass spectrometry data from intact proteins.
This project builds a common curriculum in micro and nano technologies for community colleges.
This project builds an artificial intelligence platform that helps power system operators plan and manage cost and risk.
This project uses mathematics to find out how Transformers work inside and make their decisions.
This project builds a very small optical gyroscope on a chip to sense rotation.
This project uses a network research testbed to study computer networking, cybersecurity and artificial intelligence applications.
This project builds a system that uses artificial intelligence to grade the quality of produce and guide how it is shipped.
This project builds an open-source testbed that imitates space networks with changing connectivity.
This project studies topics such as wildfire impacts on water quality, soil microbes and air pollution in the geosciences.
This project builds a system with cameras and sensors that watches continuous fiber printing and spots defects early.
This project builds methods that estimate unknown quantities from sparse and noisy data by using the physics behind the data.
